name: De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da

info.album: De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da (Japanese Version)

podcast.body: This became The Police's first US top 10 hit, cracking the top 40 in November 1980 and peaking at number 10 on the Hot 100 in January 1981. A "quintessential Sting song," its verses were "nerdy and naughty," addressing the inadequacy of language with witty lines, while the chorus consisted of literal gibberish, exemplifying Sting's juxtaposition of the erudite and the silly. "It was Zenyatta Mondatta's first US single, Didu Do Do Do, Didada Dada, which cracked the top 40 on the Hot 100 in November 1980 and peaked at number 10 in January 1981."
